title: Estée Lauder Companies outlines 2030 growth plans in ‘next chapter’ after Beauty Reimagined turnaround
summary: Estée Lauder Companies CEO Stéphane de La Faverie has said the MAC Cosmetics and The Ordinary owner aims to deliver mid-single-digit organic sales growth annually over the next four years

title: Celebrity hairdresser and salon legend John Frieda dies aged 75
summary: John Frieda, the celebrity hairstylist and founder of the eponymous hair care line, passed away on 3 November, surrounded by his family

title: DSM-Firmenich sales top €2.3 billion in Q3 2026 due to volume-led growth

title: The Soapery finds zero argan oil In ‘Argan Oil’ samples from leading retailers

title: Coty extends Marc Jacobs Beauty license for 40 years to secure ‘one of its core brands’
summary: Coty’s four-decade-long extension of its Marc Jacobs license with WHP Global and G-III Apparel Group will see it ‘accelerate’ the brand’s fragrance and make-up growth across categories and markets. This new deal extends a partnership in place since 2003
